# Psalm 140 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For the choir director. A psalm of David. LORD, rescue me from evil people! Protect me from violent men

**2** who are always scheming evil and constantly stirring up conflict.

**3** Their tongues are sharp as a snake's; viper's poison is on their lips. Selah

**4** LORD, keep me safe from the wicked! Protect me from violent people who plan to trip me up.

**5** The arrogant have set traps for me; they've spread nets and placed snares along my path. Selah

**6** I say to the LORD, 'You are my God!' Listen to my cries for help, LORD!

**7** LORD, my Lord — the power behind my salvation — you protected my head on the day of battle.

**8** LORD, don't give the wicked what they want! Don't let their schemes succeed. Selah

**9** Let the trouble they've caused come back on their own heads!

**10** Let burning coals rain down on them! Let them be thrown into fire — into deep pits they can never climb out of!

**11** Don't let slanderers gain a foothold in the land; let disaster hunt down the violent and finish them off.

**12** I know the LORD will champion the cause of the poor and bring justice to the needy.

**13** The righteous will certainly praise your name, and the upright will live in your presence.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **140:12-13**: After all the fierce prayers for justice, the psalm lands on quiet confidence: God WILL fight for the oppressed. The righteous WILL praise. The ending isn't rage — it's certainty.

— PNEUMA
